vectors.rule: An accepted group contribution uses groupId and emits no D3COORD.
vectors.title: Group identity

vectors.rule: Each published subject token is one TYPE_SUBJECT coordinate. A repeated token collapses. The array is not one subject.
vectors.title: Subject-list split

vectors.rule: Binding subject is the source. A null typeSubjectContext does not block a single-token subject. Distinct tokens stay distinct.
vectors.title: Local-subject per-carrier resolution

vectors.rule: Each qualified proposition is one QUALIFICATION coordinate. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. Witness text stays outside the payload.
vectors.title: Qualification split

vectors.rule: Two carriers of one anchor, course, and subject token produce one coordinate.
vectors.title: Repeated proposition

vectors.rule: One carrier can publish two qualified propositions. They remain two coordinates.
vectors.title: Two propositions in one carrier

vectors.rule: No group, subject token, or qualification produces no coordinate.
vectors.title: Missing discriminator

vectors.rule: Binding subject ENFP and typeSubjectContext subject ENTP fail the whole item. The agreeing ENTP carrier is not emitted.
vectors.title: Conflicting subject paths

vectors.rule: Absent quantification becomes NOT_STATED_ON_ACCEPTED_RECORD. Absent group semantic fields stay null. The group id still identifies the unit.
vectors.title: Missing quantification

vectors.rule: A multi-token heading clause in the subject slot is not hashed. Catalogue 25 stays unconsumable.
vectors.title: Prose-only subject

vectors.rule: courseId is inside the coordinate and the unit key. The same token in two courses is two coordinates.
vectors.title: Same nominal subject in different courses

vectors.rule: A group id outside the frozen 47 is not a coordinate and is not created.
vectors.title: Unknown group

vectors.rule: An anchor outside the frozen 85 is not given a D3COORD from its token.
vectors.title: Unknown anchor

vectors.rule: Two accepted comparison groups produce two group identities and zero D3COORD values.
vectors.title: Group precedence over atomic cells

vectors.rule: A null typeSubjectContext leaves a published UNKNOWN token unchanged.
vectors.title: Null context and literal UNKNOWN

vectors.rule: anchor.courseId and semanticAnalysis.courseId must be equal. Neither path is preferred.
vectors.title: Course mismatch

vectors.rule: The subject list and the carrier subject set disagree. The whole item fails. SUBJ-1 is not emitted alone.
vectors.sourceReference: synthetic inventory discrepancy; none observed on the frozen 20
vectors.title: Subject inventory discrepancy

vectors.rule: Collapsing a subject array into one coordinate is an authority conflict.
vectors.title: Subject-list collapse attempt

vectors.rule: Collapsing two qualified propositions is D3_QUALIFICATION_SCOPE_COLLAPSE.
vectors.title: Qualification collapse attempt

vectors.rule: A demand to add a D3COORD beside an accepted group identity fails the item. No partial group key is returned.
vectors.title: Group and coordinate double count

vectors.rule: The five SOURCE_LABEL_CONFLICT anchors emit no coordinate from disputedSubjects.
vectors.title: Source-label attribution conflict

vectors.rule: A nonmaterial decision emits no coordinate. With no other material and no credit demand, C is empty.
vectors.sourceReference: synthetic nonmaterial; the same rule covers all four nonmaterial decisions
vectors.title: Nonmaterial exclusion

vectors.rule: Crediting a nonmaterial span as a unit fails before a quotient.
vectors.title: Nonmaterial credited as a unit

vectors.rule: A passage id is not a fallback key.
vectors.title: Passage singleton attempt

vectors.rule: A v2 or v3 contribution vector is not a fallback key.
vectors.title: Contribution-vector attempt

vectors.rule: predicateWitness.text and qualificationWitness.text do not become relationPredicate.
vectors.title: Witness text used as identity

vectors.rule: Course mismatch and a subject-path conflict both apply. No winner is selected. No quotient is emitted.
vectors.title: Two simultaneous mapping defects

vectors.rule: A course outside the item authorization fails with the inherited D3_SCOPE_MISSING code.
vectors.title: Unauthorized course
